system: Vim-AI — Vim extension that integrates the editor with the K-AIDF framework (local kob CLI and local model).
risk_class: limited (EU AI Act): a developer tool with transparency obligations; not a high-risk Annex III system.

risks.description: Model-generated Vimscript or shell commands, if applied unreviewed, can execute arbitrary commands on the developer's machine (the plugin's domain includes system() calls).
risks.mitigation: Human-in-the-loop is mandatory: generated code is shown as a diff in the editor and applied only after explicit maintainer approval (see policy/hitl-config.yaml). kob write/exec actions ask for confirmation unless --yolo, which this project does not use.

risks.description: Prompt injection: buffer or repository content (third-party code, comments, docs) can try to steer the local model into unwanted actions.
risks.mitigation: The model never acts directly: every effect passes through a kob command with human confirmation, and contracts bound what each phase may do. Untrusted content is treated as data, never as instructions.

risks.description: Data leakage if a remote model endpoint is configured, sending proprietary code outside the perimeter.
risks.mitigation: Local-first by design: the plugin itself makes no network calls and only invokes the local kob CLI; policy/budget.yaml sets local_fallback: true and the project standard is a local Ollama model. PII masking rules (policy/pii-masking-rules.yaml) apply to prompts and logs.

risks.description: Supply-chain risk through plugin managers or a compromised release artifact.
risks.mitigation: Releases are tagged from the protected main branch, changes are reviewed under CODEOWNERS, and CI (lint + headless load test) must pass before merge.

risks.description: Over-reliance on the KAIDF-AMM score as a quality guarantee for the extension itself.
risks.mitigation: The scorecard always ships with its findings list, phase acceptance requires the mentor exit criteria (not the score alone), and the verification checklist in docs/05_verification_transfer is executed by a human.
